units.summary: Adds an idempotent setter that appends the from-selected-series hint and keeps Hints sorted. It mirrors SetStaleSeries and is persisted in block meta.
units.headline: Add SetSelectedSeries hint setter on block compaction meta
units.reason: Small new helper mirroring the existing stale-series setter; persisted format gains a new hint string.

units.summary: Adds a predicate checking whether Hints contains the from-selected-series hint.
units.headline: Add FromSelectedSeries hint predicate
units.reason: Trivial read-only helper mirroring FromStaleSeries.

units.summary: New unit test for the hint setter: idempotency and independence from the stale hint.
units.headline: Test selected-series hint set/get round trip
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: Planner now splits blocks into stale, selected and no-hint classes and plans each independently, preferring no-hint, then stale, then selected. This prevents mixing of hinted blocks so hints survive compaction.
units.headline: Planner segregates stale, selected and regular blocks into classes
units.reason: Compaction planning logic affects which blocks merge and the WAL-replay cutoff, which relates to data loss.
focus: Class priority order and whether partial-view blocks can be starved
Blocks carrying both stale and selected hints land in the stale class only
Behavior when only one class exists falls through to planClass(dms)

units.summary: Doc comment update only, covering the new hint class.
units.headline: planClass doc comment mentions selected-series hint
units.reason: Comment-only change.

units.summary: Merged block meta now keeps the from-selected-series hint if any source has it, and comments are updated. Any-source semantics are used for the stale and selected hints.
units.headline: CompactBlockMetas propagates selected-series hint from any source
units.reason: Changes persisted block metadata for merged blocks, which affects the WAL-replay cutoff.
focus: Any-source propagation versus the planner's segregation guarantee
Interaction with the all-out-of-order hint logic

units.summary: Write now copies the from-selected-series hint from the base meta to the new block meta, like the stale hint.
units.headline: Write propagates selected-series hint from base meta
units.reason: Changes hint propagation into persisted block metadata.
focus: Hint is carried when rewriting a single block
